result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a major navigation tab inconsistency, a major card truncation at the bottom of the screen, and a minor restaurant name truncation.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted as active in the bottom navigation bar, but the screen content shows the Home feed (delivery address, search bar, categories, promotional banner, and restaurant recommendations).
issues.suggestion: Ensure the active navigation tab accurately reflects the current screen. If displaying Home content, highlight the Home tab instead of Profile.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only a partial pizza image and hiding the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and cuisine information.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container height, bottom padding, or scroll behavior so that cards in the 'Popular right now' list are fully visible and not clipped by the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is partially off-screen and the name is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol...' with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual scroll indicator or use consistent peek styling so users recognize the horizontal list is scrollable.
